dedupe_keys.name: argentina gas transport and distribution pipelines and compressor stations enargas data

description: This data set on the Argentine energy open data portal, titled Gasoductos (ENARGAS), holds the natural gas transport and distribution network of Argentina with data from ENARGAS, the national gas regulator, and Resolution 120/17 of the former Ministry of Energy and Mining. Resources are transport gas pipelines (CSV and shapefile, December 2023), distribution gas pipelines (CSV updated on 2 September 2026, shapefile February 2026), transport compressor plants (CSV and shapefile updated on 10 September 2026), distribution compressor plants (July 2023), and a projected pipeline layer for the GNEA northeast gas pipeline planned by ENARSA to bring Bolivian gas to the northeast region. The record metadata were last modified on 10 September 2026. Coverage is Argentina. Files are free under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: layers are updated at different dates, attributes are not described on the record, and the projected pipeline reflects plans at the time of upload. Simulation uses are gas transmission and distribution network models, compressor outage and supply security studies, and hazard exposure of pipelines. Related records: data-argentina-hydrocarbon-ducts-res-319-93 covers ducts declared by companies, including oil and product lines.
